acceptedAnswer.text: Open the Library, choose a translation and press Make available offline. Then open a chapter from the Books pane on the left, or press Ctrl/⌘ O and type a passage such as "ps 23".
Ctrl/⌘ P opens one box for everything: type a passage ("jn 3:16") to go there, a command ("Theme") to run it, or an instruction such as "find mercy", "note ps 23:1" or "compare jn 3:16".

mainEntity.name: Does the app work without internet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A translation that is made available offline is kept whole on this device and needs no connection. Only downloading a translation, a language pack, the lexicon or guide answers needs one.
